tour.title: Hi, I'm {name}!
tour.body: Let me show you around the timer. It takes about a minute, and you can skip at any step.

tour.title: Pick your puzzle
tour.body: 3x3, 2x2, OH, Pyraminx and more, each with its own scrambles and stats. Try picking one.

tour.title: Sessions keep practice apart
tour.body: Make one per goal, like warm-ups or OH. The buttons beside it create, rename, clear or delete a session.

tour.title: Your scramble
tour.body: Scramble with white on top and green in front. The arrows go back or forward, and you can copy it or type your own.

tour.title: Time a solve
tour.body: Hold Space (or touch and hold), then let go to start. With inspection on, that starts your 15 seconds first. Space stops it.

tour.title: +2, DNF or delete
tour.body: Right after a solve you can add +2, mark it DNF, or delete it.

tour.title: Your averages
tour.body: Ao5 and Ao12 update after every solve. The Stats page has the full history and graphs.

tour.title: Make it yours
tour.body: Inspection, hold time, font size, the panel layout and a background image all live up here.
